description: SYNTHETIC HARNESS CHECK. Short sketches written by hand for the code-adapt eval (not copied from any project), with expected outcomes. They check the curated recipes and the scorer; they are not evidence of how well code adaptation works on real projects. Labels were first written on 2026-10-09 and re-labelled on 2026-10-10 for the v0.28 recipe engine (a recipe patches fully or refuses; there are no per-line manual steps); every expected patch was reviewed line by line against the catalogue changes.

cases.description: Adafruit SSD1306 sketch: include, 4-argument constructor, begin() with a named address (SCREEN_ADDRESS), SSD1306_WHITE and the old bare BLACK colour name (SH110X has no BLACK, so it becomes SH110X_BLACK).
Helper file without the Adafruit_SSD1306.h include (extern declaration, scroll and dim calls): the recipe refuses rather than guessing.
Include and begin() are patchable, but SSD1306_LCDHEIGHT has no SH110X equivalent: the whole recipe refuses instead of leaving code that does not compile.
Commented include, // and /* */ commented scroll, dim and raw-command calls, and trailing comments naming SSD1306 stay unchanged and are not manual steps.

A commented-out constructor, a commented setTextColor(SSD1306_*) call and a commented platformio lib_deps line stay unchanged; the real lib_deps entry drops the SSD1306 version (no SH110X release matches ^2.5.7).
U8g2/U8x8 sketch: the curated recipe covers the Adafruit SSD1306 library only, so it refuses (U8g2 needs a hand edit or the AI tier).
ThingPulse SSD1306Wire sketch: the curated recipe covers the Adafruit SSD1306 library only, so it refuses.
Already uses Adafruit SH110X: nothing to change, so the recipe refuses.
CircuitPython adafruit_ssd1306: Python is outside the Adafruit SSD1306 (Arduino) recipe, so it refuses.
Character LCD sketch; colour words only in a string and SSD1306 only in a comment.
#define DHTTYPE DHT22 becomes DHT11.
DHT constructors with AM2302 (an alias of DHT22) and DHT22 both become DHT11; a string literal naming DHT22 is left alone.
DHTesp::AM2302 becomes DHTesp::DHT11.
CircuitPython adafruit_dht.DHT22(...) and MicroPython dht.DHT22(...): the recipe covers the Arduino DHT and DHTesp libraries only, so it refuses.
Commented DHT constructor and commented Python constructor must stay unchanged.
Commented #define lines and a block comment naming AM2302 stay unchanged; the trailing comment on the real define is kept and is not a manual step.
Sketch already selects DHT11: nothing to change, so the recipe refuses.
Sensor type chosen through another macro (#define SENSOR_MODEL DHT22): the DHT22 identifier itself becomes DHT11.
BME280 sketch that names DHT22 only in a comment, plus a README.
One AccelStepper: setMinPulseWidth(2) is inserted after its setMaxSpeed().
Bit-banged STEP pulses without AccelStepper: the curated recipe covers AccelStepper only, so it refuses (the catalogue note asks for a check of delayMicroseconds(1) loops).
StepperDriver A4988 class: the curated recipe covers AccelStepper only, so it refuses.
setup(void); one axis already sets a pulse width and is skipped, the other gets setMinPulseWidth(2) after its setMaxSpeed().
AccelStepper in a library file with no setup(): setMinPulseWidth(2) goes after setMaxSpeed() in motionInit(); the header is untouched.
A commented delayMicroseconds(1) and a commented AccelStepper stay unchanged; the real stepper gets setMinPulseWidth(2) and the real 1 us bit-banged pulse should become 2 us.
cases.known_failure: Recipe gap: the A4988 -> DRV8825 recipe only inserts AccelStepper setMinPulseWidth(2); a bit-banged delayMicroseconds(1) STEP pulse in the same sketch stays 1 us (DRV8825 needs 1.9 us). The catalogue text that says to check delayMicroseconds(1) loops is marked implemented, so it is not repeated in the notes of a ready patch either.

cases.description: A4988 named only in comments and a /* */ commented AccelStepper: only the real stepper gets setMinPulseWidth(2).
Already sets setMinPulseWidth(2): nothing to change, so the recipe refuses.
Servo sketch and a platformio.ini that lists AccelStepper: nothing to change.
AccelStepper STEP/DIR code works unchanged.
StepperDriver A4988 class: STEP/DIR code is unchanged for the TMC2209 (microstep pins are a wiring note).
A4988 class only in // and /* */ comments; BasicStepperDriver is fine.
Bit-banged 1 us pulses are long enough for the TMC2209: no change.
Two A4988 objects, include in a header: STEP/DIR code is unchanged for the TMC2209.
BasicStepperDriver already: nothing to change.
A Python config naming the A4988 is not StepperDriver code.
Adafruit BME280 sketch reading pressure only: include, object and BME280_ADDRESS_ALTERNATE switch to the BMP280 library; the message string naming BME280 is left alone.
The sketch reads humidity, which the BMP280 cannot measure: the recipe refuses instead of deleting the reading.
PlatformIO project: lib_deps switches to the Adafruit BMP280 Library without the BME280 version; the commented lib_deps line is left alone.

cases.description: GY-BME280-3.3 sketch reading temperature and pressure at 0x76.
begin(0x76, &Wire1) passes the I2C bus to begin(), which Adafruit_BMP280 takes in its constructor: refused.
setSampling() with a humidity oversampling argument has no BMP280 form: refused.
GY-BME280 5 V sketch with BME280_ADDRESS; a commented SPI constructor stays unchanged.
SparkFun BME280 library: not the library this recipe covers, so it refuses.
Unified-sensor getHumiditySensor() has no BMP280 equivalent: refused.
Adafruit BMP085 sketch with begin() and readAltitude() without arguments: include and object switch to Adafruit BMP280.
readAltitude(101500) passes sea-level pressure in Pa; the BMP280 wants hPa: refused.
begin(BMP085_ULTRAHIGHRES) passes an oversampling mode where the BMP280 takes an address: refused.
PlatformIO project: lib_deps and the sketch switch to Adafruit BMP280; the BMP085 version is dropped.

cases.description: Three-argument Adafruit_NeoPixel with NEO_GRB + NEO_KHZ800 becomes NEO_GRBW; a comment naming NEO_GRB stays unchanged.
Two-argument Adafruit_NeoPixel(count, pin) defaults to NEO_GRB, so NEO_GRBW + NEO_KHZ800 is added.
FastLED sketch: not Adafruit_NeoPixel, so the recipe refuses (FastLED sends three bytes per LED).
NEO_RGB colour order: the RGBW order must be chosen by hand, so the recipe refuses.
Old-style assignment constructor with NEO_GRB + NEO_KHZ800 becomes NEO_GRBW.
RTClib DS1307 sketch: RTC_DS1307 becomes RTC_DS3231 and ! rtc.isrunning() becomes rtc.lostPower().
readnvram(): the DS3231 has no battery-backed RAM, so the recipe refuses.
DS1307_SquareWave1HZ becomes DS3231_SquareWave1Hz along with the class and the isrunning() check.
rtc.isrunning() used without '!': there is no DS3231 equivalent the recipe can write safely, so it refuses.
RTClib DS3231 sketch: RTC_DS3231 becomes RTC_DS1307 and rtc.lostPower() becomes !rtc.isrunning().
getTemperature(): the DS1307 has no temperature sensor, so the recipe refuses.
!rtc.lostPower() becomes rtc.isrunning().
setAlarm1(): the DS1307 has no alarms, so the recipe refuses.
Old bare WHITE and INVERSE colour names (defined by Adafruit_SSD1306.h, not SH110X) become SH110X_ names; WHITE inside a string is left alone.
